door.speaker: narrator
door.text: A door where the cathedral's floor runs out, every surface in the world pooled at its sill. It is not locked. Whatever you carry banks at the threshold; whoever is with you comes through; there is no way back up but the ending.

choices.text: [Arcane 3] I can feel the Loom through the door. It is awake, and it is waiting. Go through.
[Vaultkin] A door with no way back is a vault. I grew up in one. Go through.
[Splicekin] I can smell what is on the other side. It is not a machine and not a tree. Go through.
[Rootkin] The roots under the plaza run to this sill. I have walked it in my sleep. Go through.
[Aetherborn] The mark on me is pulling at the sill. It knows the way. Go through.
[Trueborn] Everyone who came down here was invited. I was not. Good. Go through.
Cinder, is this the way you remember?
Not yet. Extract, and come back ready.

cinder.speaker: cinder
cinder.text: It is. It was open then too. Everyone who came down here was invited; that was the trick of it. Go through. I am with you this time.
